name: PulseSync — Offline-First Field & Transit Engine
problem: Field and transit operators in low-connectivity corridors lost up to 14% of inspection and telemetry writes during cellular handoffs.
outcome: 99.4% automatic sync recovery · -41% sync support tickets · 0 data-loss incidents
architectureHighlight: Durable outbox table in Room with monotonic sequence IDs drained by unique WorkManager chains and field-level LWW conflict resolution.

name: TransitPulse — GTFS-Realtime Mobility Client
problem: Commuters saw arrival predictions up to 90 seconds stale and duplicate vehicle markers whenever WebSocket connections flapped on 3G.
outcome: Reduced cold-start time by 44% · 60fps map pan at 5.2M daily events · -67% stale arrival reports
architectureHighlight: Sequence-numbered protobuf delta ingestion into a normalized Room store; UI observes a single conflated Flow with viewport marker culling.

name: VaultPay — Hardware-Backed Consumer Wallet
problem: A 90-screen legacy Java/XML wallet suffered a 980ms cold start and non-idempotent transfer retries ahead of a mandatory security audit.
outcome: Reduced cold-start time by 58% (980ms → 412ms) · 4.8★ rating, 120k+ MAU · 0 critical audit findings
architectureHighlight: Client-generated idempotency keys persisted in encrypted Room prior to network dispatch, paired with StrongBox biometric key signing.

name: MoekyawTranslator & POS Suite
problem: Burmese-speaking merchants needed sub-150ms offline translation and reliable receipt/inventory sync without cloud latency or data egress.
outcome: 118ms median on-device TFLite inference · 85% local cache hit rate · 10k+ downloads across POS & utility builds
architectureHighlight: Quantized INT8 TFLite model executes on NNAPI/GPU delegate first; opt-in Claude API fallback streams token deltas with strict cost budgets.
